limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
The bypass requires a case-insensitive filesystem (typically Windows) and an attacker able to request /@fs/ raw filesystem paths.
No dev server was started and no case-augmented request was sent; the finding is static.
Only the 5.0.x line was verified. The 2.x, 3.x and 4.x fix commits referenced by the advisory were not inspected or set as evaluation targets.
picomatch version and its default case sensitivity were inferred from its documented default and the fix diff, not from a runtime demonstration.

critical_operation.description: Vite builds the server.fs.deny matcher with picomatch's default options plus matchBase, but without nocase. picomatch matches case-sensitively by default, while the file server on a case-insensitive filesystem (Windows, default macOS volumes) resolves any casing to the same file. A request for a denied path using different letter case therefore does not match _fsDenyGlob and is served. The advisory's fix adds nocase: true, which makes the deny patterns case-insensitive and restores the intended blacklist. The consumer is isFileServingAllowed in static.ts:216: when _fsDenyGlob(file) returns false the path is treated as allowed.

entry_point.description: A dev-server request URL is converted to a filesystem path and checked against the deny matcher; a case-augmented denied path is not matched.
